fields.Name: W2 -> S6.5 #2
fields.Description: Gate G3.4 (owner PR 4, phase 3, dataset W2, criterion S6.5): over 400 W2-noise seeds (s100–s499), at most 28 training runs of 400 reach Published through the lifecycle gate (noise-publish-400, the Wilson rule of Ruling Q8), and every other run stores a no-signal or keep-simple-baseline outcome with its reason, 100%: a KeepBaseline model with a non-empty StatusReason or a run-level refusal record with a non-empty Reason (D4-56), counted by TrainingRunID. Each seed is a Pipeline Builder agent run with automated publishing on, which trains and evaluates its run through the gate on MJAPI; a model the gate validated is then published through the Promote op. MaxExecutionTimeMS (11,059,000) is the measured 400-seed duration (7,372,485 ms, suite run 7CB62E8F-8FD0-49BD-A47B-014842558361) plus 50%, rounded up to the second. A statistical gate: PS_SEED_LIMIT=<k> runs the first k seeds with the rule applied at n = k; the full count runs once, on the final head. Mutation: store negative outcomes without their reason (LifecycleGate.Evaluate saves StatusReason = null and WriteRefusalRecord writes Reason = null) → every run that does not publish fails the reason count.

ExpectedOutcomes.summary: Over W2-noise s100–s499 at most 28 of 400 runs reach Published, and every other run stores its negative outcome with its reason (400 seeds, 1 pass).
